description: This file defines a mock class for the IMediaKeysModuleService interface used in IPC testing within the Rialto server component. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for IPC-related functionalities such as client connection management and media key operations.

classes.name: MediaKeysModuleServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeysModuleService interface for unit testing IPC interactions related to media keys management.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Mock method to simulate a client connecting to the media keys service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Mock method to simulate a client disconnecting from the media keys service.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Mock method to simulate creating media keys via IPC.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Mock method to simulate destroying media keys via IPC.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mock method to check if a key exists.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Mock method to simulate creating a key session.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mock method to generate a license request.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mock method to load a media key session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mock method to update a media key session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Mock method to set DRM header information.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Mock method to close a key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Mock method to remove a key session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Mock method to delete DRM store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Mock method to delete key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve DRM store hash.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve key store hash.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit

methods.name: getLastDrmError
